title: EU Climate & Energy Daily Briefing
subtitle: Saturday, 7 November 2026 — Key developments from the last 24 hours

highlights.headline: Tesla to 'wind down' production of flop Cybertruck
highlights.summary: Elon Musk's electric pickup for the future will start to be consigned to the past next year. The Cybertruck's bulk and crude shape meant it could only pass regulatory standards in more permissive markets.

items.title: For people in Iran, a constant threat of war and dearth of information
items.description: Most people in Iran have little idea of the course of the US-led war and peace talks on the global stage. With few sources of information, the population must navigate conflicting rumors and fears of a nuclear attack.

items.title: Spain's rail authorities face European fraud probe after Urda rail disaster
items.description: Prosecutors begin investigating EU funds meant for upgrading the Spanish railway line where a train crash killed 69 people.

items.title: European shares join a global sell-off as AI spending fears rattle Wall Street and Asian markets
items.description: European shares have fallen after sharp losses in Asia and on Wall Street. Doubts over huge AI investments and fears of curbs following the Democrats' US midterm victory have rattled global markets.
